newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil posts $130 mln trade deficit in June so far.
newsitem.headline: Brazil posts $130 mln trade deficit in June so far.

text.p: Brazil posted a trade deficit of $216 million in the third week of June, taking the shortfall for the month so far to $130 million, the Industry and Commerce Ministry said.
Brazil posted a surplus of $86 million in the first two weeks of June.
In June's third week, Brazilian exports totalled $1.162 billion while imports were $1.378 billion, the ministry said in a statement.
In terms of daily averages, exports were $232.4 million and imports $275.6 million, the statement said.
During the first three weeks of June, exports reached $3.461 billion, or $230.7 million in daily averages. Imports were $3.591 billion, or $239.4 million on average each working day.
